chapter: After Oliver: Chicago and New York
title: Depression years: theater pits, Cotton Pickers, New York
summary: He works in theater pits to 1930, tours briefly with McKinney's Cotton Pickers, goes to New York in 1933 for Fisk Williams, plays with Lips Page, and returns in 1940.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
